questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) provides a mapping from an IP address to the corresponding hardware (link-layer) address.
(ii) A single TCP segment from a sender S to a receiver R cannot carry both data from S to R and acknowledgement for a segment from R to S.

Which ONE of the following is CORRECT?
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

• Statement (i): Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) maps a network-layer IP address to its corresponding physical hardware (MAC/link-layer) address. Hence, statement (i) is TRUE.

• Statement (ii): TCP supports piggybacking, allowing an outgoing TCP segment from sender S to receiver R to carry both data from S to R and an acknowledgment (ACK) for a previously received segment from R to S. Thus, statement (ii) is FALSE.

Therefore, (i) is TRUE and (ii) is FALSE, making Option (B) the correct choice.
